description: Rangers who traverse the Feywild and gain fey powers.

features.name: Wanderer Magic
features.description: Learn fey spells and cast them using WIS.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: Summon fey creature to aid you in battle.

features.name: Fey Glamour
features.description: CHA checks have advantage. Enemies have disadvantage on hostile actions.

features.name: Fey Mastery
